title: Make Wake Artists Teams With One Twenty One Management, Home to Muscadine Bloodline & More
summary: Founded by Adam Hale, One Twenty One also has Ben Chapman and Josh Weathers on its roster.
body: Make Wake Artists has partnered with Adam Hale ‘s One Twenty One Management, the companies announced on Wednesday (Aug. 12). One Twenty One is home to artists Muscadine Bloodline , Ben Chapman and Josh Weathers. Joining Hale in the partnership is Ivan “Churro” Haro , who serves as day-to-day manager for Muscadine Bloodline, Weathers and Chapman. Haro also manages the metalcore band Glasslands. Baker, Australian Music Historian and Former Billboard Correspondent, Dies at 74 Founded by Chris Kappy in 2015, Make Wake’s roster includes stadium headliner and two-time CMA entertainer of the year winner Luke Combs , along with Flatland Cavalry, Cooper Alan, The Castellows and Dylan Marlowe. Hale served in the Ohio Army National Guard for six years before moving to Nashville to launch a music industry career. For eight years, he was on the road with artists including Newsboys, Colt Ford, Kip Moore and Brad Paisley. Along the way, he met Muscadine Bloodline’s Charlie Munca…
